final: WITH c AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT status, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.status, s.cnt AS project_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
